name: TripoSR
paper_title: TripoSR: Fast 3D Object Reconstruction from a Single Image
license_interpretation: MIT is a permissive license, so the code and weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products; the only obligation is to keep the copyright and license notice with copies. LibreYOLO's adapter is MIT; the triplane, NeRF and mesh-extraction code it adapts from TripoSR keeps MIT, and the transformer and DINO ViT encoder follow HuggingFace diffusers and transformers code under Apache-2.0, with their notices in libreyolo/models/gen/triposr/NOTICE. LibreYOLO avoids upstream's torchmcubes (MPL-2.0) by running marching cubes through scikit-image (BSD-3-Clause). The stabilityai/TripoSR weights (MIT) are redistributed unchanged as LibreYOLO/LibreTripoSR; Background removal runs on LibreYOLO's BiRefNet port with the ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet weights (MIT), from LibreYOLO/LibreTRELLISl. Both are pinned and not gated.
